svg.title: Candidate deployment and trust zones
svg.desc: Engineer Windows PCs run browser, Desktop, Web-rendered Workbench, per-user Workspace process and external Office or CAD tools. Reviewer and administrator devices use separate Web entry points. Product commands use HTTPS to a company-managed Server control plane. Large bytes move under a scoped grant directly between Workspace and one selected Artifact Gateway/Vault. Several Vault locations may exist independently of the single initial Server host.
